title: HYPRN MVP installation configuration, version 1
description: One closed JSON object, stored 0600 in a 0700 folder owned by the user, with no symbolic link in any component. The stdlib loader integration/src/hyprn_mvp_integration/installation.py enforces this schema and, beyond it, the file safety rules, duplicate-key refusal, the caller's edition, the core location rule for data_root and upstream.cache (application/src/hyprn_mvp_app/locations.py), upstream.cache inside data_root and data_root not the home folder or one of its parents. Never in the configuration: secrets, worker policy or limits, image ids.

installation_id.description: Canonical lower-case version 4 UUID, fixed at first setup.

owner_username.description: The owner's sign-in name; setup proposes the operating-system account's short name.

host_home.description: The account's home folder, which the worker containment probe proves absent inside the worker.

studies_root.description: Optional study-folder root; the shared location refusals apply.

origin.description: http://127.0.0.1:<ports.app>; the loader checks that the port is ports.app.

docker.description: The container engine discovered at setup.

agent.description: Setup writes enabled true and token_ttl_hours 8 unless the user chooses otherwise.

AbsolutePath.description: An absolute normalized path below /: no . or .. component, no repeated or trailing separator, no NUL.
